class.name: VoxelMesher
class.brief_description: Base class for the algorithms that turn a [VoxelField] into triangles.
class.description: A [VoxelMesher] is the step between a field of distance samples and a mesh that can be drawn. Assign one to [member VoxelField.mesher] and the field extracts with it from then on. Which algorithm a field uses is a property of the field rather than something fixed when it was built, so a mesher can be swapped at runtime and the field re-extracts with the new one. That is what lets a project trade smoothness against extraction cost per object, and it is why this is a [Resource] and not a mode flag. This class is abstract. Use [VoxelMesherMarchingCubes].

method.name: get_algorithm_name
method.description: Returns the name of the algorithm this mesher implements, for display and for logging which one a field ended up extracting with.
